info.title: ARPC — Achieve Resolution Partner Connect API
info.description:
FDR Wholesale API — A Hybrid Integration Model designed to maximise partner velocity without compromising enterprise data standards. DEX (Digital Enrollment Experience) is the partner-facing integration layer that powers the full applicant lifecycle. The `fdr_applicant_id` acts as the applicant's passport across all systems, persisted from first eligibility check through enrollment. All endpoints require a valid Bearer JWT with the `arpc.all` role.

**Published:** 2026-08-08

tags.name: Phase 1: Quoting and Identity Anchoring
tags.description: Establish the applicant's journey and capture PII without cluttering the enterprise core. Eligibility Scout → ID Generation → Identity Anchoring → Async Credit Fetch.

tags.name: Phase 2: Program Generation
tags.description: Transition from a registered identity to a credit-backed debt resolution program. Stateless Readiness Check → Async Polling Loop → Program Result Persistence.

tags.name: Phase 3: Enterprise Lead Promotion
tags.description: Formalise the application within the enterprise ecosystem for underwriting. Synchronous Orchestration → UW Submission → Banking Disclosure.

tags.name: Phase 4: Fulfillment and Enrollment
tags.description: The final transition from applicant to active client. DRA Readiness Check → Embedded DRA Signing → Enrollment.

post.description: **Recommended endpoint.** `POST /v1/applicant/register` is deprecated and will be retired by end of July 2026 (deadline can be extended on request if your team needs more time). Identity Anchoring: Persists applicant PII to Achieve's managed partner CRM and generates the `fdr_applicant_id` — the applicant's passport across all systems. Routes to the correct target system based on seller identity, and triggers the async credit fetch. Requires a valid Authorization header.

400.description: Validation failure (ER40001), Salesforce OAuth failure (ER40112), Salesforce registration rejection (ER40012), or Salesforce validation error (ER42212). Field-validation failures (ER40001) return all violations in a single response via `errors[]`; each entry carries a stable `reason_code` (REQUIRED, INVALID_FORMAT, OUT_OF_RANGE, UNDERAGE) for programmatic branching. SF / OAuth failures use the top-level `error` field and omit `errors[]`.

post.summary: Submit application to underwriting (v2 — auto banking disclosure) — recommended
post.description: **Recommended endpoint — supersedes v1.** Submits a wholesale application to the underwriting system. On full UW approval (`sub_status = 'UW Approved'`) the banking disclosure email is sent automatically — no separate `send-email` call is needed in this path. Conditional approvals suppress the auto-send; in that case the manual `POST /v1/application/send-email/{fdrApplicantId}` endpoint can be used. Uses the SF Object API directly (no suip-proxy hop). Requires a valid Authorization header.

post.description:
Exchange your client credentials for a Bearer JWT using the OAuth 2.0 `client_credentials` flow.

**Steps:**
1. In the server selector above, switch to **STG OAuth server** (`https://oauth.stg.ffngcp.com`).
2. Click **Authorize** (lock icon) and enter your `client_id` as Username and `client_secret` as Password under **basicAuth**.
3. Send this request — the response contains your `access_token`.
4. Copy the `access_token` value.
5. Click **Authorize** again and paste it into the **bearerAuth** field.
6. Switch the server back to **API Gateway** before making API calls.
7. All subsequent API calls will include `Authorization: Bearer <token>` automatically.
